aesthetic: Gerstner Pressprint — warm paper materiality underpins an exposed editorial grid where steel-grey type and hairline rules carry all the visual weight
chromaticArc: Slides 1–2 sit on Warm Paper; slide 3 (section divider) drops to Carbon for the one dark beat; slides 4–5 resurface through Grid Linen back to Warm Paper, crossing light/dark three times in five frames.
gridStrategy: Title zones migrate across the column axis — full-width col 0 span 58 on slide 1, right-offset col 35 span 23 on slide 2, narrow sidebar col 0 span 15 on slides 3–4, and centred col 12 span 36 on slide 5 — so the visual anchor shifts with each page turn.

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: Georgia appears on the editorial pull-quote slide (slide 4) to introduce warmth against the steel-dust accent bar; Courier New is reserved for data-label elements and running captions to enforce the 'monospace as texture' directive

accentStrategy: Thin horizontal rules (type: line, span 40–58) cleave title zones from body columns on slides 1, 3, and 5; a vertical accent bar (span 2, full row height) anchors the sidebar edge on slides 2 and 4 — touching roughly 40% of slides with Steel Dust or Carbon geometry.
